components.css: .ds-score { max-width: 560px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text); } .ds-score-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-score-head h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-score-out { font: 700 1.5rem/1 'Space Grotesk', Inter, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-score-out small { font-size: 1rem; color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-score-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(10, 1fr); gap: 6px; } .ds-score-row button { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--text); font: 600 1rem/1 Inter, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-score-row button:hover { background: var(--panel-raised); } .ds-score-row button[aria-pressed=true] { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-score-row button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (max-width: 599px) { .ds-score-row { grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); } }

components.css: .ds-title-card { width: 200px; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text); } .ds-title-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-title-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-title-card, .ds-title-card:hover { transition: none; transform: none; } } .ds-cover { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--tint-1); display: flex; align-items: flex-end; padding: 14px; } .ds-cover-name { color: var(--on-tint); font: 700 1.0625rem/1.25 'Space Grotesk', Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-badge { position: absolute; top: 10px; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 6px; font: 700 0.8125rem/1.6 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-badge-rank { left: 10px; background: var(--scrim); color: var(--on-scrim); } .ds-badge-slop { right: 10px; background: var(--danger); color: var(--on-danger); } .ds-card-name { padding-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 4px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.0625rem; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-rating { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-rating svg { color: var(--accent); } .ds-rating span, .ds-genres { color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-genres { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 0.875rem; }

narrative.overview:
MangaRec is a bookshelf a group of friends stocks together. The covers are the books. Everything else is the shelving: dark, even and quiet, there to hold the covers up rather than compete with them. The colour and personality on any screen come from the manga art, plus one soft blue that marks what's selected, rated or active, like a coloured tag clipped to a shelf.

It feels soft and friendly rather than technical. Corners are generously rounded (10–16px), filters are pills, cards rise a few pixels when you point at them, and people show up as round initials in their own colour. The density is relaxed: panels breathe, cover rows scroll sideways, and the text reads like a group chat ("Most rated by the group", "Found something worth reading?"), not a report.

Dark is the default, and light mode is a full equal. Both come from the same CSS variables, so every rule here applies to both. Scores support the covers. MangaRec is a shelf, not a stats dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Manga covers (2:3) are the main imagery and the main source of colour.
One accent, Shelf-Tag Blue, for anything selected, primary or rated.
Flat, tonal depth: page → panel → raised, separated by 1px hairlines.
Soft rounded shapes and pill filters, with a small hover lift on cards.
Space Grotesk for headings, Inter for everything else.
Dark-first, with a fully supported light mode driven by the same tokens.

rules.name: The One Tag Rule
rules.body: Shelf-Tag Blue is the only accent. It marks what's selected, primary or rated, and nothing decorative. If something new needs to stand out, use weight or space, not a second accent.

rules.name: The Status-Only Hues Rule
rules.body: Mint, lilac, coral and plan blue mean a read status and nothing else. Don't reuse them for categories, charts or decoration.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Colours exist only as variables in src/index.css. Components use palette names (primary.main, divider, textSecondary) or var(--token). There are no exceptions.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Buttons, pills and headings are sentence case (textTransform: none). Nothing in the UI is all-caps.

rules.name: The Score Is Bold Rule
rules.body: A score is always 700 weight, next to a Shelf-Tag Blue star ("8.4", "9 /10"). The count or "/10" after it is in Muted Slate at a lighter weight.

rules.name: The Radius Unit Rule
rules.body: Write radii as px strings in sx ("10px"). A bare number gets multiplied by the theme's 10px base.

dos: Do let covers carry the colour. Keep the chrome around them in the neutral tones.
Do use Shelf-Tag Blue (primary.main / var(--accent)) for the one primary action and for selected, current or rated states.
Do separate surfaces with tone and a 1px var(--border) hairline before reaching for a shadow.
Do keep radii in the established steps (6 / 10 / 12 / 16px, pills at 999px), written as px strings.
Do check every new token in both [data-dark] and [data-light], and add the light value in src/index.css when the dark one fails on white.
Do give motion a prefers-reduced-motion fallback, as hoverLift does.
Do write muted text as color="textSecondary". MUI 9 silently ignores text.secondary on Typography.
donts: Don't turn the home page into a data dashboard. No charts or stat tiles leading the page. Scores support the covers.
Don't add a second accent colour, or reuse the status hues for anything except read status.
Don't hard-code colours in components. Add a token to src/index.css instead.
Don't load images from uploads.mangadex.org. Covers come only from the app's own storage.
Don't write responsive border shorthands like border: { md: 1 }. They reset the colour, so write the full "1px solid var(--border)".
